project.title: eDNA barcoding of protists for environmental monitoring of aquafarming activities
project.description: Goal of the study is the evaluation of protistan eDNA meta barcodes from environmental samples as indicators for environmental quality. The impact includes the implementation of protistan eDNA barcoding in routine environmental monitoring programs
